programs.title: Compass
programs.desc: Six artists spend seven days on the edge of the Great Sandy Desert. Here, a wildlife sanctuary has been set up, where reintroduced animals are thriving. The artists find inspiration and hope as they paint up a storm.

programs.title: Songs of Praise
programs.desc: Sean Fletcher meets broadcaster, writer and former Songs of Praise presenter Sally Magnusson in the beautiful Scottish countryside to reflect on her faith and favourite hymns.

programs.title: ABC News At Noon
programs.desc: Melissa Mackay presents the latest from ABC News on the weekend bringing you today's top stories and coverage of events as they unfold. Plus original reporting, analysis and updated news, sport, weather and information.

programs.title: Landline
programs.desc: A tasty sampler of stories from the land - covering food, agriculture, crops, climate, business and innovation - as we meet the fascinating people who make our rural and regional communities unique. Presented by Pip Courtney.

programs.title: Gardening Australia
programs.desc: Jerry visits a subtropical food forest, Millie sheds light on garden lighting, Josh transforms a sandpit into a habitat for birds and frogs, Tammy makes a tabletop arrangement and Hannah visits a windswept coastal garden.

programs.title: Race Around The World
programs.desc: Six filmmakers are sent to surprise global locations and given ten days to make a film, where three esteemed judges critique their work.

programs.title: Creative Types With Virginia Trioli
programs.desc: Award-winning broadcaster Virginia Trioli explores the essence of creativity with some of our best loved artists at the peak of their powers. Virginia's first guest is literary sensation Trent Dalton.

programs.title: Restoration Australia
programs.desc: Host Anthony Burke meets a First Nations family aiming to reinterpret a simple and remote timber church into a getaway home honouring dispossessed ancestors and proud culture.

programs.title: Back Roads
programs.desc: Back Roads journeys to Kandos, on the edge of the Great Dividing Range in New South Wales. This is a town famous for making cement, where Heather Ewart finds an unlikely arts festival is reshaping the community.

programs.title: Antiques Roadshow
programs.desc: The Roadshow visits Thirlestane Castle in the Scottish Borders where treasures include a Rod Stewart Gold Disc, a chalice thought to have been found in a potato field, and a gold, enamelled snuffbox gifted by a Russian Tsar.

programs.title: Compass
programs.sub_title: The Taboo of Us - with Hannah Ferguson
programs.desc: New media entrepreneur Hannah Ferguson is on the rise but back home in Orange with her mum Philippa, a different Hannah emerges. Despite their political differences, both are dedicated to empowering women in their own ways.

programs.title: ABC News Hour
programs.desc: News from where we live. ABC News NSW brings you the day's top stories, exclusive investigations and original reporting on issues that matter to you. Presented by Jeremy Fernandez, and sport with Arianna Levy.
